description: This file defines the data structures and some mock data for live activity attributes used in an iOS application with a widget extension, particularly for managing connection states and activity information.

classes.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes
classes.description: Defines shared attributes for live activities, including agent name, session key, and nested ContentState data.

classes.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes.ContentState
classes.description: Represents the state of the activity, including status text, connection state booleans, and timestamp.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Provides a static example instance of OpenClawActivityAttributes for preview purposes.

methods.name: connecting
methods.description: Provides a static instance of ContentState representing a connecting state.

methods.name: idle
methods.description: Provides a static instance of ContentState representing an idle state.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Provides a static instance of ContentState representing a disconnected state.
